description: A gray tabletop holds an open cardboard storage box near the back, with a small white piece on the surface, a yellow lemon-shaped object to the right, and a small ring-like item nearby. The left hand reaches in and flicks the small white piece up and forward into the open box, then later lifts the yellow object and tosses it into the box as well; afterward, the left hand moves to the small ring-like item at the right edge and picks it up from the desk.
